supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded creation of ext.rwong by sara.ali at 13:43:56 UTC, using the same logon session previously recorded for sara.ali on the domain controller.
The new account was added to the Contractors group. Its ext.<name> naming and Contractors membership match the stated help-desk process for temporary accounts.
The available account-creation records do not show ext.rwong being added to an administrator group; the recorded addition is to Contractors.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC due to an outage, so proxy activity in that interval cannot be assessed. Winsec, Sysmon, and the listed Zeek sensors were reported as available.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish who requested ext.rwong or the business purpose and approval for the account.
The records do not establish whether sara.ali's credentials were used by sara.ali personally or by another party.
The provided records do not establish whether ext.rwong had other group memberships or what activity the account performed after creation.
unrelated_findings: sara.ali launched Remote Desktop to FILE-COP-01 and established an interactive logon there. This is outside the alerted account-creation activity and appears inconsistent with the inventory statement that remote administration is only performed from WS-PBECKER-01; investigate separately.
